name: foresight-lens-banish-while-distant-glimpses-four
notes: The generator filed this printed ACTIVATED ability in the play-time $cardActivatedAbilities table, so the field click was routed through ActivateCard (the item treated as a card being played): the effect ran but the printed REST / banish-self / sacrifice cost was never paid and the item could be re-used for free every time. Registered as a field activation ($activateAbilityAbilities in Custom/GameLogic.php; ActivatedAbilityCost pays the cost) and the play-time body neutralized in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php. While the champion is distant the glimpse is 4 instead of 2.

rulesClauses: Banish Foresight Lens: Glimpse 2. If your champion is distant, glimpse 4 instead.

engineBug.summary: Foresight Lens never banished itself: it could glimpse for free repeatedly.
